description: Approves (the draft becomes the article's text) or rejects a pending drafted version of an article (version_id from draft_handbook_edit or read entity sop_versions), as the article's Approve and Reject do. The same decision again answers success; the other decision on a reviewed version is refused. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: review_handbook_edit
title: Approve or reject a drafted article edit
